scope: Current computed8 and intrinsic8 preIR focused cases only. Review existing production implementation, no SLG edit or new native build.
structure: CSharp InferTryExpression first infers the complete operand, then checks Result operand, enclosing Result return, error type and ownership. SLG preIrResultPropagationDecisionByNode computes direct/unary/binary/conversion/member/flow types and stores canonical propagation decisions before IR; context_prepare and diagnostic emitter consume that same decision.
branches: SLG resultPropagationDecision status1 nonResult,2 enclosing function,3 error mismatch,4 ownership correspond to CSharp checks. Binary operand inference uses canonical numeric/logical operand decisions; an invalid child remains the primary error rather than inventing a Result type. Known intrinsic len/capacity result kinds and invalid argument counts are handled separately from resolved nominal methods.
logic: Composed operand type feeds the propagation check. Intrinsic receiver storage is materialized through canonical type helpers, preserving array/Text length, dynamic capacity and nominal method return identities. Known computed Int/Bool rejection and Result-returning nominal method acceptance stay distinct; no name-based pretending that every len returns Int.
diagnostics: Original16 exact locations and messages are retained. CSharp operand errors precede outer propagation checks; SLG existing first-blocking diagnostic selection and canonical source location render the same primary error. Arity messages are emitted at call target location; diagnostic-only compile failures are expected nonzero outcomes, not successful runtime checks.
